template_text: Most AI demos chase scale. This project starts small: helping people find kosher food across the South Shore of Massachusetts. By turning fragmented public information into structured, source-linked data, we can support families, visitors, synagogues, and small businesses with a practical community tool.
caveat_slot: Certification scope matters; every listing should remain source-linked.
